entries.title: Checks show their time for a run a crewmate started by hand
entries.body: When a crewmate starts a GitHub or GitLab run that is not part of a pull request, such as a release, and waits for it, the summary that opens on that crewmate and its task record now show the run as its checks: how long it has been running, such as running for 42m, and once it ends how long it took.

picture.alt: A crewmate's summary for Cut the next Infinitary alpha, waiting for checks, with its checks reading running for 42m.
